_comment: Copy to resume/master.json. This is the ONLY source of resume and cover-letter text: the generators select and order what is here, they never invent claims. Text is treated as trusted LaTeX, so 	extbf{} and \& work. tags are archetype letters from config.json; keywords drive matching against a job description.

headlines.A: Headline used for archetype A roles

summaries.A: Two or three sentences used as the summary for archetype A roles.

experience.title: Your Title
experience.intro: Optional one-line scope statement under the role header.

bullets.text: Something you actually did, with 	extbf{the part that matters} in bold.

projects.title: Project name
projects.text: What it is and why it matters.
